rulings.title: Evry uses reviewed writes
rulings.user_response: I think review first makes sense, we can improve on that later
rulings.ruling: Authorized reads and non-persistent drafts may run immediately. Every durable Evry change requires human review and approval of the exact proposal before execution. Autonomous mutation classes are deferred; future exceptions require a new decision.
rulings.scope: Future v3 product specification; no implementation or v2 source change

rulings.title: Private weekly check-ins remain outside Evry
rulings.ruling: Initially exclude private weekly check-in answers, notes and history from every Evry tool and model context, while preserving native planter-only entry, corrections and history. An ordinary Owner grant is not permission to transmit these records to a model. Any future access to explicitly selected entries requires a new product decision. Coaching, network and oversight access is not broadened.
rulings.scope: Future v3 product specification; no implementation or v2 source change

rulings.title: Recording preserves an advanced person stage
rulings.ruling: Recording another interview or commitment preserves an already advanced person stage. Only an explicit stage-change action may demote the person. Interview outcomes, human judgments and commitment meaning remain intact; this ruling does not invent additional progression rules.
rulings.scope: Future v3 product specification; no implementation or v2 source change

rulings.title: First-time Vision attendance uses Vision history
rulings.ruling: First-time Vision attendance is based on prior attended Vision meetings. Attendance at an unrelated team or ministry meeting does not make someone a returning Vision attendee. Invitations and RSVPs are not attendance. Use the existing chronological meeting basis, and preserve the distinct committed/core-group classification. The automatic first-time Vision follow-up uses this definition.
rulings.scope: Future v3 product specification; no implementation or v2 source change

rulings.title: Separate follow-up outcome from task completion
rulings.ruling: Record contacted, attempted but no contact, administrative completion, and no longer needed as distinct follow-up outcomes. Only confirmed contact updates actual-contact freshness. Task completion is measured separately; completing a person-linked administrative task or logging an attempt does not establish contact. No longer needed remains closure without successful-completion credit.
rulings.scope: Future v3 product specification; no implementation or v2 source change

remaining_decisions: Other open decisions and architectural review findings remain unresolved. Acceptance of these five rulings does not establish whole-plan build readiness.
